{{Top|leg}}
The '''Great Jawenko''' was the name given to a [[Jawenko lava beast]] that arrived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] from [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], and was considered a [[Deity/Legends|deity]]/[[Demon/Legends|demon]] in [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]]/[[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken]] mythology.<ref name="Spare Parts">{{JournalCite|11|Spare Parts (short story)}}</ref> [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker Lars]] was labeled as a mate of the Great Jawenko and a [[Witch/Legends|witch]] after her son, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], had [[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|massacred]] a [[Unidentified Tusken village/Legends|Tusken village]] that was the home of the [[Rrhr hunting band]], and who was reputed to be the [[Parent/Legends|parents]] of Skywalker, known to them as the "Demon Outlander."<ref name="News">{{SW|url=news/barely-tolerable-alien-henchmen-of-the-empire-part-2|series=Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>
